identity.name: Presage Sharp Edged Series
identity.one_liner: The 2020 Presage Sharp Edged Series — the 39.3mm GMT with the 12-sided faceted bezel and the 6R64 caliber. The most-cited modern Seiko Presage.

narrative.story: The SARY195 is the 2020 Presage Sharp Edged Series, the 39.3mm GMT with the 12-sided faceted bezel. The 6R64 caliber is the hand-wind, hacking, 45-hour reserve GMT. The 100m water resistance, the sapphire crystal, and the 4R-style 6R64 movement are the 2020 specification. The Sharp Edged is the most-cited modern Seiko Presage and the watch a collector cites when they want a Seiko dress watch with a GMT complication at the $1,100 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The Sharp Edged Series has a 12-sided bezel that references the 1962 Seiko Crown Chronograph. The 6R64 is a hand-wind, hacking GMT with a 45-hour reserve.
